description: This Java class represents a request to send a command to a Zigbee device, encapsulating command details such as endpoint, cluster, manufacturer-specific info, and payload. It constructs and executes device requests in a Zigbee mocking context.

classes.name: SendCommandRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to send a Zigbee command, including command parameters and execution logic.

methods.name: SendCommandRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the request with specified parameters and decoding the payload.

methods.name: getCommandId
methods.description: Returns the command ID associated with this request.

methods.name: executeDeviceRequest
methods.description: Executes the command on the specified Zigbee device, handling manufacturer-specific commands if applicable.
